meta.purpose: V3 -> V4 LP migration, WITHDRAW side. Staged Safe transactions to decreaseLiquidity + collect every live Uniswap-V3 position held by the DAO Safe, then optionally burn all emptied NFTs. Fork-proven on mainnet-96369 anvil fork.
meta.amountMin: 0 (no slippage floor; DAO withdraws its own liquidity in full — see report note)

forkProof.method: Executed the withdraw batch's exact execTransactionData through the real Safe (execTransaction, operation=1 delegatecall -> MultiSendCallOnly) with a threshold-1 approvedHash signature, on a fresh mainnet-96369 anvil fork at block 1082950.
forkProof.safeTxHash_note: EIP-712 hash of (to=MultiSendCallOnly, value=0, data=withdraw blob, operation=1, safeTxGas=0, baseGas=0, gasPrice=0, gasToken=0, refundReceiver=0, nonce=0). Mainnet Safe nonce is 0 at fork block; recompute via getTransactionHash if the nonce advances before execution.
forkProof.conservation: Single-tx batched Safe delta equals the sum of the 10 per-position withdraw deltas.

withdraw.description: PRIMARY. For each of the 10 live positions: decreaseLiquidity(full) then collect(max) to the Safe. Recovers all value. Sign + execute this first.

burnAll.description: OPTIONAL cleanup. Burn all 74 emptied NFTs (10 live must be withdrawn first, then 64 dust). Execute AFTER the withdraw batch has been mined.

v4MintSide.note: Second half proven separately on the luxd 0x9999 V4 pool manager (NOT executed here). After withdraw, deposit tokens via swapDeposit(token,amount), initialize(poolKey,sqrtPriceX96), swapPlace(...).
